title: ItipAscription
description: ITIP rootless facet — the ITIP-wide statement concerns carried by every non-Archetype ascription statement distributed in an ITIP framework. Composed through allOf by the seven ITIP base Archetypes, and therefore inherited by every domain and organization framework Archetype derived from them. Rootless: it has no top-level $ref and never determines a GSM subject type. Archetype statements carry the same members directly at the top level because gsm/Archetype is sealed. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).

framework.description: Framework membership — the framework version that authors, governs, versions, and distributes this ascription statement. Intrinsic to the ascription version; never rewritten by organization selection.

name.description: Stable canonical framework name, in lowercase kebab-case.

version.description: Version of the framework package owning the statement (semantic version).

authorship.description: Authorship — an ITIP concern, not a GSM or DM concern. For human-authored statements ITIP derives it from the authenticated session and MUST reject or ignore client-supplied values. For system-authored statements the registered technical client declares it and it is trusted by admission: suitable for provenance and audit context, never non-repudiation evidence.

identity.description: Human or system identity, unique within the issuer.

identityIssuer.description: OIDC issuer, client registry, or other issuing authority.
